typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was standard for academic and formal publishing in the early 20th century.
